stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz - Jiri Lehecka en directo, la final del ATP de Tokio en vivo|Comienza el partido

en.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Jiri Lehecka live, ATP Tokyo final underway
en.summary: Alcaraz plays in the ATP Tokyo final against Lehecka, seeking to defend his title from the previous year in his first match after over four months away from competition.

stories.title: El Constitucional ampara por siete votos a cinco a los líderes del procés frente a la decisión del Supremo de no amnistiar la malversación y allana la vuelta de Puigdemont

en.title: Constitutional Court protects by seven votes to five the pro-independence leaders against Supreme Court's decision not to grant amnesty for embezzlement and clears way for Puigdemont's return
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court ruled seven to five in favor of Catalan independence leaders regarding the amnesty issue, with the court divided between conservative and progressive justices.

stories.title: Francis Halzen gana el Nobel de Física por descubrir el origen de los neutrinos de alta energía, "las partículas fantasma" que llegan del espacio exterior

en.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering the origin of high-energy neutrinos, 'phantom particles' arriving from outer space
en.summary: Belgian scientist Francis Halzen, aged 82, won the prestigious Nobel Prize for his pioneering experiments with the IceCube Neutrino Observatory in Antarctica, which opened a new field of neutrino astronomy.

stories.title: La fiscalía abre una investigación contra un ‘youtuber’ por comentarios homófobos sobre el futbolista Héctor Bellerín

en.title: Prosecutors open investigation against YouTuber for homophobic comments about footballer Héctor Bellerín
en.summary: Prosecutors launched an investigation against a YouTuber who made derogatory comments about footballer Héctor Bellerín based on his personal style and interests.

stories.title: La Fiscalía de Madrid abre diligencias contra un youtuber por comentarios homófobos sobre Bellerín

en.title: Madrid's Public Prosecutor's Office opens proceedings against youtuber for homophobic comments about Bellerín
en.summary: Prosecutors have launched an investigation into content creator Iñaki Angulo following homophobic remarks he made about Real Betis footballer Héctor Bellerín during a live broadcast. The complaint was filed by a sports transparency association and later supported by about a hundred people.

stories.title: Claves sobre la huelga general por la vivienda: ¿qué argumentan los sindicatos? ¿qué opina CEOE? ¿cuándo fue la última?

en.title: Key points about the general strike for housing: what do unions argue? what does CEOE think? when was the last one?
en.summary: The trade unions CCOO and UGT are calling for a 24-hour general strike without a set date, following public outcry over a housing eviction case involving Maricarmen. The article examines union arguments, employer confederation positions, and historical context.

stories.title: Sabadell blinda su futuro con la entrada estratégica del grupo francés BPCE, que compra el 7%

en.title: Sabadell secures its future with strategic entry of French group BPCE, which buys 7%
en.summary: French bank BPCE has acquired a 7% stake in Banco Sabadell, valued at approximately 1.186 billion euros, with a commitment not to exceed 9.99% ownership. The investment represents a strategic partnership between the two financial institutions.

stories.title: La Fiscalía investiga al youtuber Mikel Angulo por insultos homófobos a Héctor Bellerín

en.title: Public Prosecutor investigates youtuber Mikel Angulo for homophobic insults against Héctor Bellerín
en.summary: The content creator used derogatory language to insult Real Betis footballer Héctor Bellerín during a live stream on his channel. Prosecutors are investigating the incident following a complaint.

stories.title: El Sabadell arma un escudo contra opas con la venta de un 7% al banco francés BPCE

en.title: Sabadell shields itself against takeovers with sale of 7% stake to French bank BPCE
en.summary: Sabadell sold a 7% stake to French banking group BPCE, with the two entities planning future commercial agreements. BPCE could potentially acquire up to 9.9% of Sabadell's capital.

stories.title: La CEOE considera “inadmisible” la huelga general y duda de su encaje legal

en.title: CEOE deems general strike "inadmissible" and questions its legal standing
en.summary: Spain's business confederation criticized a general strike, arguing it improperly shifts pressure onto companies to achieve legislative and budgetary changes related to housing.

stories.title: La CEOE advierte de que la huelga por la vivienda es "inadmisible" al no ser "de naturaleza laboral" y estudia ya acciones legales

en.title: CEOE warns housing strike is "inadmissible" as it lacks "labor nature" and studies legal action
en.summary: The business confederation accused unions of directing political pressure costs onto companies through a strike not based on labor issues, while the Labor Ministry defended the strike's legitimacy.

stories.title: El francés BPCE pacta la compra “amistosa” del 7% de las acciones del Banc Sabadell

en.title: French BPCE agrees on "friendly" purchase of 7% stake in Banc Sabadell
en.summary: BPCE completed an agreement to acquire 7% of Sabadell's shares with a board seat, and may increase its holding to 9.9% of the capital.

stories.title: Las nuevas exigencias a las empresas para incluir en un contrato laboral que entraron en vigor el 5 de octubre

en.title: New requirements for companies to include in employment contracts effective October 5
en.summary: A new regulation effective October 5 requires companies to specify in writing employment contract details including salary, contract type, work schedule distribution, algorithmic systems, artificial intelligence use, and equality or harassment policies.

stories.title: Las principales medidas del nuevo decreto de vivienda, explicadas una a una

en.title: The main measures of the new housing decree, explained one by one
en.summary: Spain's official gazette published a new housing decree containing detailed measures and figures approved by the government across 96 pages, analyzing key aspects of the housing policy.

stories.title: Las amenazas nucleares de Putin ya no surten efecto

en.title: Putin's nuclear threats no longer have the intended effect
en.summary: Russia's weakening deterrence capacity is producing global repercussions, including some negative consequences related to nuclear threats.

stories.title: El Ibex toma impulso con el tirón de los bancos

en.title: The Ibex gains momentum with the pull from banks
en.summary: The Spanish stock index seeks to consolidate gains as rising US debt interest and French risk premiums create mixed signals for equity market sentiment.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez comparece hoy tras el Consejo de Ministros que recupera los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Pedro Sánchez appears after Cabinet Council that restores housing decrees
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez will address the public following a Cabinet meeting where housing decrees are expected to be reapproved with minor technical modifications, after announcing parliament dissolution and calling early general elections for November 29.
